annotations.title: Edition in hand (reading proof), step 2: check the three values

description: ANSWERS: "does this reading proof hold", "did the author of this citation have the edition". Takes the edition, the statement, the date and the three values (in the order reading_challenge listed the cells), or a proof line of the form FRC-READ:<source>-<period>:<date>:<statement hash>:<v1>;<v2>;<v3> together with the statement. Returns how many of the three cells match the edition as restated, whether that edition is still the latest one restated, and the proof line to print next to the citation. Correct values are never returned on a miss. Anyone can repeat the check offline from the edition file. A match shows the values were read from the edition; it does not show the statement is true or was derived from it.

date.description: UTC date YYYY-MM-DD the proof was made for (required unless proof is given)

period.description: Edition period YYYY-MM (required unless proof is given)

proof.description: Optional: a full FRC-READ proof line instead of source, period, date and values

statement.description: The statement the proof was made for, unchanged

values.description: The three values, in challenge order, as plain numbers as the edition holds them (46275 or 46,275; a percentage as printed, e.g. 31.25)
